title: How to Import Categories via CSV File
chunk_text:
Article: How to Import Categories via CSV File
Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558401-how-to-import-categories-via-csv-file

## Overview
To import a category structure via CSV, navigate to My Members >> Member Categories in your Brilliant Directories admin dashboard. Preparing a clean CSV file ensures that top-level, sub-level, and sub-sub-level categories are structured accurately.

## CSV File Formatting
Your CSV file must include headers for Top Level Category, Sub Category, and Sub-Sub Category. Do not include special characters or trailing spaces. Maximum recommended categories per batch upload is 1,500 rows.

## Upload Steps
1. Go to My Members >> Member Categories.
2. Click the 'Import Categories' button in the upper right corner.
3. Choose your formatted CSV file and click 'Validate CSV'.
4. Review the field mapping preview.
5. Click 'Import Now' to finalize.

## Troubleshooting
If categories fail to import, ensure the file is saved in UTF-8 encoding. Common errors include missing parent categories or duplicate row entries.

title: Email Accounts and Notifications Setup
chunk_text:
Article: Email Accounts and Notifications Setup
Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558363-emails-email-accounts

## Overview
Brilliant Directories allows directory owners to send system notifications, member welcome emails, and billing receipts. Navigate to Emails >> Email Accounts to configure outbound SMTP and default sender addresses.

## Default Sender Information
Specify the 'Default Sender Name' and 'Default From Email'. All automatic transactional notifications (lead alerts, payment receipts, password resets) will originate from this address.

## Custom SMTP Integration
To maximize email deliverability, integrate third-party SMTP providers like SendGrid, Mailgun, or Amazon SES. Enter your SMTP Host, Port (587 or 465), Username, and API Key in the Advanced Email Settings.

## Troubleshooting Bounce Rates
Verify your domain's SPF and DKIM DNS records to prevent emails from landing in spam folders.

Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558389-settings-general-settings-social-media-tab

## Overview
The Social Media tab under Settings >> General Settings enables website owners to link their Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube accounts.

title: Can I Send Mass Email Campaigns Using Brilliant Directories?
chunk_text:
Article: Can I Send Mass Email Campaigns Using Brilliant Directories?
Section: Mass Email Capabilities
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558357-can-i-send-a-mass-email-campaign-using-brilliant-directories-

## Mass Email Capabilities
Brilliant Directories includes a built-in Newsletter and Mass Email tool under Emails >> Send Newsletter. It is designed for announcements, community updates, and promotional broadcasts to registered members.

## Sending Limits and Guidelines
Standard server limits allow up to 5,000 emails per month on shared plans. For larger lists exceeding 10,000 contacts, we strongly recommend connecting an external email marketing provider like Mailchimp or using SendGrid Webhooks.

## Unsubscribe Compliance
Every newsletter sent through the system automatically inserts an unsubscribe footer in compliance with CAN-SPAM regulations.

title: Connecting Stripe Payment Gateway
chunk_text:
Article: Connecting Stripe Payment Gateway
Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558420-connecting-stripe-payment-gateway

## Overview
Stripe is the primary payment gateway supported natively by Brilliant Directories for recurring subscription billing and one-time purchases. Navigate to Finance >> Payment Gateways.

## Setup Steps
1. In Finance >> Payment Gateways, select 'Stripe' from the supported gateways dropdown.
2. Click 'Connect with Stripe' or manually enter your Stripe Publishable Key and Stripe Secret Key.
3. Configure webhook endpoint: Copy the Webhook URL provided in the BD admin and paste it into your Stripe Dashboard under Developers >> Webhooks.
4. Enable webhook events for customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_succeeded, and invoice.payment_failed.

## Supported Currencies & Refunds
Stripe supports over 135 currencies. Refunds must be initiated from Finance >> Transaction History or directly within the Stripe Dashboard.

title: Configuring Search Filters and Member Search Results
chunk_text:
Article: Configuring Search Filters and Member Search Results
Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558450-configuring-search-filters-and-member-search-results

## Overview
To customize how visitors search your directory and how member listings appear, navigate to Content >> Edit Post Settings or Settings >> General Settings >> Search Settings.

## Filtering Options
Members can be filtered by Location (Radius, City, State, Country), Category (Top/Sub), Keyword, and Custom Field values. Location searches utilize Google Maps API or OpenStreetMap depending on your settings.

## Search Results Layouts
Choose between Grid View, List View, and Map View. You can customize the sorting order (Featured members first, highest rated, alphabetical, or closest distance).

title: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
chunk_text:
Article: Connecting a Custom Domain Name and Free SSL Certificate
Section: Domain Mapping Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558475-setting-up-custom-domain-name-and-ssl

## Domain Mapping Overview
Every Brilliant Directories website comes with a temporary staging domain (e.g. yourname.directoryup.com). When ready to launch, point your live custom domain.

## DNS Configuration
1. Log into your domain registrar (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, etc.).
2. Add an A Record: Host '@' pointing to the IP address displayed in your BD Dashboard.
3. Add a CNAME Record: Host 'www' pointing to your root domain.

## Free SSL Certificate
Once DNS propagates (typically 1-4 hours), click 'Install Free SSL' in the BD Dashboard. Brilliant Directories provisions a free Let's Encrypt SSL certificate automatically renewing every 90 days.

title: Lead Generation and Automatic Member Matching
chunk_text:
Article: Lead Generation and Automatic Member Matching
Section: Overview
Source: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558500-lead-generation-and-auto-matching-settings

## Overview
The Automatic Lead Matching system routes incoming visitor inquiries to qualified members based on category and geographic location. Navigate to Leads >> Lead Settings.

## Matching Rules
Configure whether leads match based on exact top-level category or also match sub-categories. You can set a maximum radius (e.g., 25 miles) and cap the maximum number of members receiving each lead (e.g., up to 3 members).

## Monetizing Leads
Directory owners can provide leads for free, charge a fee per lead purchase, or include lead credits as part of premium membership plans.

Bulk member management is handled via CSV under My Members >> Member Export and My Members >> Import Members.

Filter members by status (Active, Pending, Cancelled) or plan level, then click 'Export Members to CSV'. The export includes user IDs, names, emails, company info, and addresses.

## Importing Guidelines
